purpose: References for the expanded 4D family roadmap; this is a planning record, not an implementation or runtime test.

initial_reference.use: Family discovery only; proposed mechanical choices are separated from manufacturer-confirmed features.

families.planned: Original complete four-rail track, linked controlled vehicles, profile editor.

families.confirmed: Manufacturer lists legacy installations, alternative seating, variable flipping, and chain or LSM propulsion.
families.planned: Compact free-spin vehicle with legacy offset pivot preset.
families.unverified: Exact seat grouping, pivot dimensions, and coupling require further visual or engineering reference.

families.confirmed: Magnetic spin influence; loading affects motion; brochure specifies eight riders in pairs, four on each side.
families.planned: Eight-seat vehicle, multiple carrier groups, magnetic inducer and damper spans.
families.unverified: Exact mechanical coupling between seat pairs.

families.confirmed: No generation-specific topology established by the primary source inspected.
families.planned: Independently rotating carrier preset with revised pivot geometry, pending verification.
families.unverified: Exact second-generation seating and pivot arrangement; no installation or historical specification asserted.
families.chosen_specification: Original inspired eight-seat variant: four independent pairs, longitudinal ±3, lateral ±3, parent pivot height 1.5, child hinge offset -0.5. Native empty pair mass 4, first moment 1.5, hinge inertia 1.9947916667. Historical generation geometry remains unverified.

families.confirmed: Free inertial seat rotation; specification section lists four four-rider cars (sixteen riders), physical carriage catch, lift/release, return braking, and unloading. A larger twenty-rider installation is described separately in the same brochure.
families.planned: Linked free-spin shuttle with lift catch/release and final station capture.
families.unverified: Exact vehicle geometry; compact and tall examples are design targets rather than copied installation specifications.
families.chosen_specification: Original sixteen-seat train, maximum four cars, native six-block couplings, two independently rotating pairs per car; fixed Create-powered winch and physical constrained carriage. Compact/tall two-spike examples are game layouts, not manufacturer loop replicas.

track_strategy.standalone: Ship independently authored complete functional tracks.
track_strategy.integration: Optional provider adapter; vehicles require their matching functional track family and verified running-gear fit, independently of appearance or provider identity.
track_strategy.future_arrow_4d: Implement and test against an inspectable Track Styles release; do not block our releases or claim compatibility with unreleased code.
track_strategy.appearance_removal: Fallback applies to appearance-only changes; external blocks require explicit migration.

licensing_references.relevance: Distinguishes protected expression from ideas, systems, and methods of operation; does not establish project-specific permission.
Explains that copyright reservation does not supply general copying, modification, or redistribution rights.

licensing_decision: Write original runtime integration for separately installed Track Styles subject to its applicable terms. Do not copy or bundle its code/assets. Existing MIT-vs-ARR mismatch remains unresolved; no legal clearance or maintainer agreement claimed.

planned_compatibility_policy.source: User design requirements; these are planned rules, not claims about real rides or tested upstream behavior.
planned_compatibility_policy.four_d_carts: Require corresponding functional track family/variant. Ordinary or other-family track is forbidden even with matching gauge or locked seats.
planned_compatibility_policy.ordinary_carts: May use 4D main rails only with verified running-gear contact geometry and structural clearance; receive no 4D seat behavior.
planned_compatibility_policy.appearance: A cosmetic Arrow 4D style does not qualify ordinary track. Functional conversion and mechanism validation are required.
planned_compatibility_policy.external_providers: Verified equivalent functional tracks may qualify through the same family and fit contract.
planned_compatibility_policy.recovery: Rail access is separate from towing eligibility. Check couplers and every vehicle; a disabled 4D cart must remain on matching track with supported carrier retention.
planned_compatibility_policy.enforcement: Server validates placement, assembly, snap/re-engagement, dispatch, transitions, and rebinding; each vehicle in a linked consist is checked.
